fields.label: Bill of Quantities
fields.description: Set when rows are bulk-inserted by api/boq_matrix.bulk_insert_boq_items; left empty for rows edited inline on the parent BOQ. The CORE-04 gate counts rows by this field.

fields.label: Pay Item Number
fields.description: The pay item / DPWH numbering carried over from the Excel paste.

fields.label: BIM Element (GlobalId)
fields.description: The IFC GlobalId of the element this line measures. Takes a takeoff's own element-to-line mapping, which an issue's element reference cannot: that is per-topic, so an element nobody raised an issue about has no line.

fields.label: Planned Start
fields.description: Start of the planned window. Drives PV in the S-curve (D-026); without it the curve degenerates to a straight line.

fields.label: Planned End
fields.description: End of the planned window. A zero-length item (planned_end == planned_start) counts 0 before its start and 1 at or after it.

fields.label: Actual % Complete
fields.description: Progress actually achieved. This is EV's only source, kept deliberately separate from the planned dates so SPI can be less than 1.
